purpose: Full provenance for all five product-feature groups. Contains feature descriptions and source references only; no customer data, quotation prices, contacts or copied customer PDF.
review_method: Read original app page2.py; visually inspect complete source quotation pages 2, 3 and 5 and twin brochure pages 2-7. Source files remain unchanged.

LEGACY_FEATURES.source_scope: General descriptions reproduced from the earlier single-DG quotation and original app. Exact applicability to every catalog model is unverified.
LEGACY_FEATURES.title: Product features & equipment

highlights.text: Designed for economical operation and maintenance, with a proven engine for rugged use.
highlights.evidence: Low operating and maintenance cost; proven engine and rugged usage.

highlights.text: Service interval: 500 operating hours / one year, subject to the selected model's confirmed maintenance schedule.
highlights.evidence: Maintenance interval printed as 500 Hrs./1Year. Restored only with model-specific confirmation.

highlights.text: Wide service network across India, with coordinated sales, service and spares support.
highlights.evidence: Wide service network across India; umbrella sales and service. Spares support also appears in the original company service description.

highlights.text: CPCB IV+ emission compliance and remote monitoring are subject to confirmation for the selected model and scope.
highlights.evidence: CPCB IV+ compliant and remote monitoring. Both retained as model- and scope-dependent claims.

highlights.text: Compact footprint to support efficient use of installation space.
Single-window warranty support; warranty duration and any extended 5C cover follow the confirmed commercial terms.
highlights.evidence: Single-window warranty policy and 5C extended coverage. Conflicting hard warranty periods are replaced with a reference to confirmed commercial terms.

engine.text: Mechanical engine configuration and fuel-consumption performance to be confirmed for the selected model.
engine.evidence: Mechanical, Low Fuel Consumption. Mechanical configuration and consumption performance now require selected-model confirmation.

engine.text: Electric starter motor and battery-charging alternator.
Lubricating oil and coolant supplied prefilled.
Starting battery: one 12 V DC battery where applicable; confirm the selected model's starting system.
engine.evidence: 1 x 12V DC Battery. Retained only where applicable with final starting-system confirmation.

engine.text: Nominal engine speed: 1500 rpm, subject to model confirmation. Engine model and rated output are listed in the technical specifications.
engine.evidence: Model, BHP and RPM: 1500. Speed is qualified; variable model and output ratings remain in technical specifications.

alternator.text: Compact, lightweight construction with sealed bearings.
alternator.evidence: Compact Build; Sealed Bearings; Light Weight.

alternator.text: IS/IEC 60034-1 conformity, subject to confirmation for the supplied alternator.
alternator.evidence: Complies with IS/IEC60034-1. Reworded as conformity subject to supplied-alternator confirmation.

alternator.text: Voltage, phase rating, power factor and permitted load imbalance must match the confirmed supplied configuration.
alternator.evidence: Original specifies 415 V, 0.8 PF and 10% phase imbalance under a single-phase quotation heading. Numeric claims are omitted from this shared profile; configuration-specific confirmation replaces them.

alternator.text: Selected kVA and kW ratings are listed in the technical specifications.
alternator.evidence: Capacity-specific kVA and kW values are retained in technical specifications, not repeated as fixed generic values.

controller.text: SEDEMAC GC111X family controller, where specified, with ARM-based processing, graphic LCD and backlit display.
controller.evidence: Sedmac GC111X (ARM-based) with Graphic LCD & Backlit Display. Model is conditional; vendor name typography normalized.

controller.text: Operating modes: AMF, manual and remote start/stop for supported single-phase and three-phase systems.
controller.evidence: Modes: AMF, Manual, Remote Start/Stop (1 phase and 3 phase).

controller.text: Engine monitoring: oil pressure, coolant temperature, fuel level, battery condition and running hours.
controller.evidence: Engine Monitoring: Oil Pressure, Coolant Temp, Fuel, Battery, Hours.

controller.text: Alternator monitoring: line-to-neutral and line-to-line voltage, current, kW/kVA, frequency and power factor.
controller.evidence: Alternator Monitoring: Voltage (L-N, L-L), Current, KW/KVA, Frequency, PF.

controller.text: Engine protections: low oil pressure, high temperature, overspeed, sensor faults, low fuel and battery-voltage faults.
controller.evidence: Protections: Low Oil, High Temp, Overspeed, Sensor Faults, Low Fuel, Battery Volts.

controller.text: AC protections: under/over voltage and frequency, overload, load imbalance and sensing faults.
controller.evidence: AC Protections: Under/Over Voltage & Frequency, Overload, Load Imbalance, Sensing Faults.

controller.text: Maintenance alerts based on running hours and service due date.
controller.evidence: Maintenance Alerts: Run Hours & Due Date.

controller.text: Communication interfaces: USB, RS485 and CAN; configuration through the front panel.
controller.evidence: Communication: USB, RS485, CAN; Front Panel Configurable.

enclosure.text: Designed to meet applicable MoEF / CPCB requirements; confirm certification for the supplied enclosure and DG set.
enclosure.evidence: Specifically designed to meet stringent MoEF / CPCB norms. Certification confirmation is explicit.

enclosure.text: Operating range of 10 to 55 degrees C without external cooling is subject to confirmation for the selected model and site conditions.
enclosure.evidence: Performs from 10 degrees C to 55 degrees C without external cooling. Retained only subject to selected-model and site confirmation.

enclosure.text: Fire-retardant acoustic insulation using PU foam or rockwool, as specified for the supplied enclosure.
enclosure.evidence: Fire retardant insulation (PU Foam / Rockwool). Supplied-material qualification added.

enclosure.text: Draw-out fuel tank for maintenance, with external fuel-filling provision outside the canopy.
enclosure.evidence: Draw-out fuel tank for easy maintenance; external fuel filling provision outside canopy.

enclosure.text: Compact footprint with easy access to serviceable components.
enclosure.evidence: Compact design with lowest footprint; easy access for serviceable parts. Unsupported superlative lowest is removed without removing compactness or service access.

enclosure.text: Common mild-steel base frame with anti-vibration mounting pads.
enclosure.evidence: Mounted on common MS base frame with AVM pads.

enclosure.text: Emission after-treatment system (ATS), as applicable to the confirmed model.
enclosure.evidence: After Treatment System (ATS) for emissions. Model applicability is explicit.

enclosure.text: Model-specific dimensions and fuel-tank capacity are listed in the technical specifications.
enclosure.evidence: Capacity-specific dimensions and fuel-tank capacity remain in technical specifications.

display_section_notes.highlights: Confirm model-specific service intervals, emission certification, monitoring and warranty scope.
display_section_notes.engine: Confirm final engine control type, fuel-consumption data and battery arrangement.
display_section_notes.alternator: Electrical ratings must match the confirmed model and phase selection.
display_section_notes.controller: Confirm the controller model and enabled functions for the supplied system. AMF operating capability does not mean that a separately priced AMF panel is included.
display_section_notes.enclosure: Confirm construction, temperature capability, acoustic performance and compliance for the selected model.

LEGACY_FEATURES.display_note: General feature descriptions; final equipment configuration, certification and included scope must be confirmed for the selected model. Model ratings are listed in the technical specifications.

TWIN_500_FEATURES.source_scope: Supplied 500/640 kVA twin DG brochure; technical values taken only from its 500 kVA column.
TWIN_500_FEATURES.title: Twin DG features & equipment

highlights.text: Twin-engine arrangement supports parallel or single-engine operation to match changing demand.
highlights.evidence: Parallel or single-engine operation to match actual load requirements.

highlights.text: Intelligent load sharing and selective engine operation support efficient partial-load running.
highlights.evidence: Intelligent load distribution and selective operation for efficient partial-load operation.

highlights.text: Dual-unit architecture provides redundancy and operational flexibility during maintenance or component issues.
highlights.evidence: Dual-unit redundancy, operational security and availability during maintenance/component issues. No full-load availability guarantee is added.

highlights.text: Designed for fluctuating power requirements, with benefits for non-linear loads and motor starting described in the brochure.
highlights.evidence: Fluctuating power need, better non-linear load performance and higher motor starting capability.

highlights.text: Coordinated monitoring and maintenance support uptime and equipment life.
highlights.evidence: Predictive/preventive maintenance and monitoring support uptime and equipment life.

highlights.text: Remote monitoring through app and web platforms supports generator or fleet oversight.
highlights.evidence: App- and web-based remote monitoring of a generator or fleet.

engine.text: Mahindra H6935G1 electronic engines with TCIC aspiration.
engine.evidence: Engine make Mahindra & Mahindra; H6935G1; Electronic; aspiration TCIC.

engine.text: Six cylinders per engine (6 x 2); displacement 9.3 x 2 L.
Engine speed: 1500 rpm. Starting system: 24 V.
Rated engine output: 620 hp, as printed in the brochure.
engine.evidence: Rated Power Output (Hp): 620. Source does not explicitly say per-engine or combined.

engine.text: Lubricating oil capacity: 35 x 2 L. Coolant capacity: 31 x 2 L.
engine.evidence: Total lube oil capacity 35 x 2 L; system coolant capacity 31 x 2 L.

engine.text: Lubricating oil change interval: 500 operating hours.
engine.evidence: Lube oil change period: 500 Hrs. No one-year condition is added.

alternator.evidence: Enclosure type IP23; insulation class H.

alternator.text: 415 V, three-phase, 50 Hz; 0.8 lagging power factor.
alternator.evidence: 415 V; 3 phases; 50 Hz; 0.8 lagging power factor.
Prime duty; 500 kVA; 400 kW system rating.

controller.text: Intelligent synchronization and real-time monitoring coordinate the two generating units.
controller.evidence: Advanced control algorithms, real-time monitoring and intelligent synchronization. Controller photographs do not establish a universal model number.

controller.text: Parallel and single-engine operating modes allow output to follow the load requirement.
controller.evidence: Parallel or single-engine mode and twin synchronization logic.

controller.text: Automated failover capabilities support continued operation within the available generating capacity.
controller.evidence: Automated failover capabilities. Wording limits continued operation to available generating capacity rather than promising uninterrupted full capacity.

controller.text: Remote monitoring covers running hours, engine health, rpm, error logs and operating parameters through app and web platforms.
controller.evidence: Running hours, health, RPM, errors and operating parameters via app/web remote monitoring.

controller.text: Maintenance support includes A-check/B-check notifications, preventive schedules and automated maintenance reminders.
controller.evidence: A-check/B-check notifications, tailored preventive maintenance schedules and automation of maintenance tasks.

controller.text: Fuel management tracks filling events, consumption patterns and fuel traceability.
controller.evidence: Fuel-event records, fuel consumption patterns and traceability.

enclosure.text: Twin engines and alternators are arranged on a common base with a central control-panel assembly, as illustrated in the brochure.
enclosure.evidence: Visual illustration shows twin engines and alternators on a common base with central control/AMF panel. This is an illustration observation, not a contractual scope assertion.

enclosure.text: The illustrated arrangement includes radiators, air-filter assemblies, batteries and ATS assemblies.
enclosure.evidence: Illustration labels radiator, air-filter assembly, batteries and ATS. ATS abbreviation is retained without assigning an unsupported expansion.

enclosure.text: Integrated fuel-tank capacity: 780 L. DEF tanks: 50 + 50 L.
enclosure.evidence: Fuel tank 780 L; DEF tank 50 + 50 L.

enclosure.text: Approximate overall dimensions (L x W x H): 8800 x 1600 x 1975 mm.
Cold-starting system, PMG, RTD, BTD, space heater and external AVR are listed as optional accessories.
enclosure.evidence: Optional accessories: Cold Starting System, PMG, RTD, BTD, Space heater, External AVR.

display_section_notes.highlights: Performance and running-cost benefits depend on load profile and operating conditions; no quantified savings or uninterrupted full-load output are guaranteed.
display_section_notes.engine: The brochure prints 620 hp without explicitly identifying it as a per-engine or combined value. Final engine supply details require confirmation.
display_section_notes.alternator: Specifications are from the 500 kVA column of the supplied twin DG brochure.
display_section_notes.controller: Confirm controller model, interfaces, enabled protections and connectivity scope. The illustrated AMF/control arrangement does not establish inclusion of a separately priced AMF panel.
display_section_notes.enclosure: Confirm enclosure finish, acoustic rating, temperature range and certification. Optional accessories are included only when expressly priced in the quotation.

TWIN_500_FEATURES.display_note: Source: supplied Twin DG Set 500/640 kVA brochure, pages 2-7. These descriptions apply to the 500 kVA (250 x 2) configuration. Confirm the final supplied configuration before order.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: Warranty duration/hour limits conflict; original app also selects a shorter warranty for any capacity starting with 5.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Single-window warranty support and any extended 5C cover are retained, governed by final commercial terms. No hard warranty duration, hour limit or unexplained five-year entitlement is asserted.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: 415 V, 0.8 PF and 10% maximum phase imbalance appear under a single-phase heading.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Numbers are not displayed in the shared legacy profile, even conditionally. Voltage, phase, power factor and imbalance are to match the confirmed supplied configuration.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: Mechanical engine control and a single 12 V starting battery are generic original text.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Retained as explicitly model-dependent legacy descriptions; never transferred to 500 kVA twin, whose brochure specifies electronic engines and 24 V starting.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: CPCB IV+, 500-hour/one-year maintenance and 10-55 degrees C operation are generalized.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Retained only in the legacy profile with explicit model, certification and site confirmation. No legacy temperature or service-year condition is asserted for twin DG.
Controller functions and interfaces are restored, with final model/enabled-function confirmation. AMF operating capability does not imply inclusion of an independently priced AMF panel.
Compact footprint retained; unsupported universal comparative superlative removed.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: Up to 40% reduction in fuel consumption and CO2 emissions.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Qualitative demand matching and running-efficiency benefits retained. Percentage omitted because the brochure supplies no test basis or guaranteed operating conditions.
Redundancy and automated failover retained without promising full rated output after loss of one generating unit; continued operation is bounded by available capacity.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: Controller pictures and an illustrated AMF panel.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: No SEDEMAC GC111X, USB, RS485, CAN or detailed legacy protection list is assigned to the twin system. Final controller and priced panel scope require confirmation.
Preserved as printed without asserting it is per engine or combined.
No 400 kVA feature profile; source covers 500/640 kVA only. Engine, alternator, controller and enclosure details await supplier confirmation.

omissions_and_resolutions.claim: Legacy brushless, self-excited, sealed-bearing and IS/IEC 60034-1 statements.
omissions_and_resolutions.resolution: Not transferred to twin profile because the twin brochure does not establish them.
Retained as optional descriptions only; included commercially only when expressly priced.
